title: TERM: Target-Free Jailbreak Defense via Entropy-Guided Residual Modulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13577v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across diverse applications, making both safety and utility essential for reliable deployment. Jailbreak attacks use diverse forms of adversarial prompting to bypass alignment safeguards and induce LLMs to generate harmful responses. Some representation-based defenses regulate internal activations using predefined steering directions or learned safety regions. However, adapting intervention to each input without a predefined representational target while limiting over-refusal remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose Target-free Entropy-guided Residual Modulation (TERM), an inference-time defense that uses prompt-calibrated attention entropy deviations to guide adaptive modulation of the model's own residual updates. translated_title: TERM：通过熵引导残差调制的无目标越狱防御
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在多种应用中展现出强大的能力，使得安全性与实用性对于可靠部署而言都至关重要。越狱攻击利用各种形式的对抗性提示绕过对齐防护机制，诱使大语言模型生成有害响应。一些基于表示的防御方法使用预定义的引导方向或学习到的安全区域来调节内部激活。然而，在缺乏预定义表示目标的情况下，如何针对每个输入自适应地施加干预，同时限制过度拒答，仍然是一个挑战。在本文中，我们提出了无目标熵引导残差调制（TERM），这是一种推理时防御方法，利用提示校准的注意力熵偏差来引导对模型自身残差更新的自适应调制。由于注意力模式在不同的提示和解码步骤之间会有所变化，原始熵值难以被解释为一致的干预信号……
tldr: 提出了TERM这一推理时防御方法，利用提示校准的注意力熵偏差自适应地调制模型自身的残差更新，在无需预定义表示目标的情况下防御越狱攻击，同时限制过度拒答。
en_tdlr: TERM is an inference-time defense that adaptively modulates the model's own residual updates using prompt-calibrated attention entropy deviations, providing target-free jailbreak defense while limiting over-refusal.
